result: At pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk commit 4a738b9dd99eaca418b614afa433a0cbdaf8d056, source-level serialization is sufficient to show that a legacy InitializeRequest built from a ClientInfo carrying the tasks extension preserves that declaration at params.capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks"] = {}. ClientCapabilities::enable_tasks inserts the empty settings object and the pinned unit test verifies its JSON serialization; ClientInfo aliases InitializeRequestParams; InitializeRequest fixes method=initialize; and Request/WithMeta serialization forwards the serialized params object without stripping capabilities. InitializeRequestParams::new defaults protocolVersion to 2025-11-25 at this commit. This does not prove scheduled-Chat product control of ClientInfo, deployed server acceptance, task execution/persistence, transport enablement in ChatGPT, or end-to-end richer-mode parity.
